cds.text: Describe everyday events and chance experiment outcomes; order outcomes by likelihood; identify independent and dependent events
List possible outcomes of chance experiments with equally likely outcomes and compare with those that are not equally likely
Recognise probabilities on a 0-1 or 0%-100% scale; estimate event likelihoods using common fractions, percentages and decimals
Conduct repeated chance experiments to observe relationships between outcomes; describe variation in results
Conduct repeated chance experiments with and without equally likely outcomes; use frequency to compare outcomes and estimate likelihoods
Run repeated experiments and simulations with increasing trials using digital tools; compare with expected results and discuss how more trials affect variation
